title: Controlled study primary endpoint
text: In a controlled study of 120 participants, the treatment group showed a statistically significant improvement (p < 0.01) on the primary endpoint compared to placebo.
instructions: Classify the research fragment into exactly one claim kind.

criteria.empirical_finding: Reports observed data, measurements, or statistical results from a study or experiment.
criteria.method_claim: Describes a method, procedure, architecture, or how something was done rather than what was observed.
criteria.opinion: Authorial judgment, speculation, or recommendation without direct empirical support in the fragment.
criteria.other: Does not clearly fit empirical finding, method claim, or opinion.
